changelog: Native React Bits Branched Sidebar: Integrated the React Bits BranchedMenu directly into the chat history drawer sidebar with curved bezier branches, glowing reach strokes, and gliding trunk markers
Live File & Artifact Branching: Chats automatically branch out to reveal all associated files, live artifacts, scratch notes, and user uploads directly beneath each conversation node
Branch File Management & Quick Note Creator: Added a '+ New Note / File...' action on every chat's branch allowing instant file creation and editing directly from the sidebar
One-Tap Branch Toggle: The top-bar CallSplit action now toggles expand/collapse for all conversation branches across the sidebar
Seamless File Viewer & IDE Integration: Tapping any file branch directly opens it in the rich Markdown reader or the code editor
